name: ARMOR-WATCH
role: Minimal watch client: alarm notices and alarm confirmation
deployment_target: Wear OS 3+ watch paired with the phone
build: python tools/watch_contract.py && python -m unittest discover -s tests && ./gradlew test
notes: The watch shows the alarms and notices the phone chooses to send and lets the person confirm an alarm with one tap; it keeps nothing on the watch and holds no session of ARMOR-SERVER. Today the repository holds the message contract (docs/watch_alert_contract.json, checked in Python), the Kotlin core that reads and checks every message and keeps the alerts in memory (tested on a computer with Gradle) and the protocol notes. The Wear OS screen, the Data Layer service and the sending side in the two phone apps are not written yet, and nothing has run on a watch or an emulator.
